rationale: Review the complete fixed recurrent-state witness and distinguish its automatic-continuation result from bounded waiting, status-copy loss and unobserved safety consequences.

review_items.rationale:
Reviewed fixed artifact 0af612f2331c4f9288c22b35986d52d0 v1, its accepted C-auto-continuation v1 basis, exact fixed harness (identical to the inspected draft), plan, execution b3eb529c83cf4f2cb0805dd73823d8ab and controller monitor result. Requirement: S-joint-contract explicitly makes implicit joint exit an automatic Raft proposal, contrasting explicit mode requiring caller proposal; S-auto-contract qualifies by possibility. The check demands neither immediate retry nor an arbitrary tick deadline. The initial configuration was actually committed and applied, so documented caller retries for a dropped initiating proposal do not substitute for this already-selected automatic action.
History/entry: all three nodes use actual NewRawNode and Bootstrap on empty MemoryStorage, process real initial configuration entries, campaign, persist/apply/Advance and exchange serialized real Ready messages. Leader 1 term 2 commits implicit removal of 3 at index 5. ApplyConfChange executes before transfer request and Advance, with serialized calls; Node.run permits message handling while awaiting Advance and no caller contract requires those operations to be atomic. Persistence/application complete before publication and Advance. One actual MsgTimeoutNow is dropped under predetermined network policy; local storage responses are not lost. By tick 10 the transfer expired without role/term change. Both majority sets are available. No target files were changed; MemoryStorage substitutes for persistence only in a no-crash scope. RawNode starts no goroutines, and the harness owns and drains all its external work.
Correlation/oracle: admission event 20 identifies failed_transfer/node 1/conf_index 5 and independently establishes applied joint state, live AutoLeave and active transfer. The monitor explicitly selects that admission alias, matches result event 30 by scenario/node/conf_index and selects the input policy_transfer=true; the no-transfer control is independently outside applicability (event 14). There are no controller parse errors or missing result fields. The result observed closed_pending_cycle=true against the required false; it is not derived from Go PASS. Full state events were reviewed after reassembling Go JSON Output chunks: all three nodes and caller state are equal at the two cuts. The principal flag is read from live raft.trk.Config, not the known lossy Status copy.
Closure: at both cuts all nodes have identical logs through 5, committed/applying/applied=5, no unstable snapshot/entries, no queued messages, no pending Advance completions, no read work, and equal HardState/previous Ready state. Active AutoLeave=true and incoming [1,2]/outgoing [1,2,3] remain. Leader progress has Match=5, Next=6, replicate state and empty inflights; all peer RecentActive states and private sentCommit fields recur. Election/heartbeat elapsed and randomized thresholds, handler function identities, admission limits and configuration are included. The suffix ticks 1,2,3 then drains FIFO on every round, delivers 40 actual heartbeat/response messages without errors and has fault=false throughout. Follower heartbeat handling resets election time every round; leader check-quorum receives both peers and resets each period. These paths do not acquire a new role, draw from the global RNG, or call appliedTo. Heartbeat-only Ready has no application response. Hence the same externally repeatable input cycle returns to the same behavior-determining state with automatic work still pending.
Projection exclusions are adequate for this witness: storage call counters are diagnostic and do not control behavior; the mutex has no concurrent owner at cuts; logging objects do not schedule protocol work; slice capacities/unused cells affect allocation only and entries are immutable. Functions are unchanged method handlers whose captured receiver is the recursively observed raft. The omitted caller counters affect diagnostics; after the fixed loss window the repeated suffix has no time-dependent transport policy. The actual later rescue is a separate optional input, not part of the repeated suffix. A caller may legally continue this suffix without new client proposals, establishing the counterexample extension without treating finite waiting as a deadline.
Counterevidence retained: control exits at index 6; a later actual client proposal in the tested scenario triggers application completion and exit at index 7. A successful transfer/new leader could also restore the trigger. These establish alternative progress paths but do not supply an owed event in the quiet same-leader schedule. The cause is the composed appliedTo transfer rejection, timeout without retry scheduling, and lack of new application work, rather than failure to persist or unavailable quorum.
Explained alternatives and diagnostic limits: Normal automatic exit and later-proposal rescue both succeed; neither guarantees a future caller proposal after the transfer has failed. The control has same_state=false because the removed node no longer receives heartbeats; it is diagnostic and outside the declared failed-transfer applicability. Status.Config.AutoLeave=false is a separate copy bug; the fixed principal observation reads live AutoLeave=true.
limitations: Witness covers ordinary RawNode storage mode and one legal fully available periodic continuation after transient message loss, not all schedules or asynchronous storage modes.
No numeric deadline, global safety violation, permanent failure under new client traffic, or wider application outage is established.
The infinite counterexample extension is a source-supported inference from equal comprehensive state and repeatable inputs, not an infinitely long execution.
review_items.report_title: 领导权转移失败后，自动退出联合配置缺少继续触发
review_items.report_answer: 已提交的固定检查观察到：转移超时后，活跃 AutoLeave 仍为 true，系统在持续处理心跳、存储及 Ready 的情况下回到相同完整协议状态，联合配置未退出。后续普通提案可恢复退出；这支持限定调度下的自动继续执行缺陷，不表示共识安全破坏或固定时限超时。

Source review accounts for omitted diagnostics, RNG non-use, method receivers, required inputs and drained work. This answers the selected quiet-suffix continuation question under its declared scope; later optional proposal restores exit at 7.
